game.title: Dying Light 2 Stay Human
game.blurb: Open-world first-person zombie survival action RPG with parkour, set in the city of Villedor, from Techland, released 2022-02-04. RAWG average playtime: 23 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: From reaching Villedor and the Bazaar to any of the endings, with the hidden story milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Reclaiming the City
chapters.summary: Water Towers, Electrical Substations, Windmills, Metro Stations, Facilities and faction alignment.

chapters.title: GRE Sites, Camps and Encounters
chapters.summary: GRE Quarantines and Anomalies, Airdrops, Bandit Camps, Encounters and Nightrunner Trials.

chapters.title: Collectible Notes, Recordings and Graffiti
chapters.summary: Finding every Collectible Note, Recording and Graffiti Tag.

chapters.title: Survival, Parkour and Combat
chapters.summary: Nights, Volatiles, chases, crafting, weapon mods, proficiency, health and stamina, and fighting feats.

chapters.title: Co-op
chapters.summary: Joining co-op sessions and fighting alongside other players. Needs online play.

chapters.title: Carnage Hall
chapters.summary: Skullface, Carnage Hall, its shows, trials and collectables.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Dying Light 2 Stay Human" or "Dying Light 2". dyinglight.fandom.com answers the API with about 158 linked articles, including "Aiden Caldwell", quests such as "A Place To Call Home", "Book Club I" to "Book Club X", and "Achievement and trophy"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam store list names app 534380 "Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Reloaded Edition", the edition now on sale; it is the same app as the original release. The Steam schema calls it "Pinhead" (an internal codename). 11 of 65 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story chapter, though the last three ("Night of Terrors", "My Friend, Ciro", "Skullcrusher", 10 to 13%) sit between the Carnage Hall achievements and may belong to that content. Carnage Hall and Skullface have their own chapter because the achievements name them; the data does not name the add-on they come from.
